title: Junior Video Editor
description:
Basic Headline Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $5 USD/hour to $10 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

A recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the past few months)

Ability to break down why a viral video or high-performing ad worked

Comfortable reading performance metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and adjusting accordingly

Skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently

Takes ownership and applies feedback consistently

Preferred

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Exposure to AI video tools, talking heads, or voiceover formats

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Full visibility into TikTok and Meta performance data on your own work

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You prefer a fixed schedule or close day-to-day supervision

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD

100% remote, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

Flexible schedule with no required timezone overlap — async communication daily

Flexible paid time off, coordinated with the team

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok and Meta analytics

No micromanagement

How to Apply

Applications take about five minutes. We review every submission.

title: Job Title: Creative Content Specialist & Digital Media Producer (Video, Graphics & Copy)
description:
Job Title:

Creative Content Specialist & Digital Media Producer (Video, Graphics & Copy)



About the Role:

We are looking for a versatile, detail-oriented content creator to lead end-to-end digital production across our platforms. This role spans dynamic short-form and long-form video editing, carousel and graphic design, daily social media scheduling, and engaging blog copywriting to promote our wellness products, sound/meditative offerings, and services.



Core Responsibilities:

Video Editing & Motion Graphics:



Edit and produce polished, high-retention video content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube using Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, and Capcut.



Create engaging hooks, clean transitions, subtitling/captions, and sound integration (working with meditative soundscapes, guided practices, and product demos).



Repurpose hero footage into platform-native short-form clips.



Graphic & Product Content Design:



Design visual assets using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator/Canva.



Produce swipeable multi-slide educational carousels, single-image quote/practice cards, and launch graphics.



Create clean, branded mockups and promotional graphics for product features and seasonal announcements.



Social Media Management & Publishing:



Plan, format, and schedule daily organic posts across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

With input from client so this does not all land on you.



Write engaging, brand-aligned captions with targeted hashtags and clear calls to action. (*this will be input from mostly client, but again, teamwork makes the dreamwork).



Collaborate on the monthly content calendar and posting strategy.



Copywriting & Website Content:



Write accessible, thoughtful blog posts and reflective articles for our website to support SEO and reader education. (Again this is mostly copy checking client will be writing the blogs).



Draft promotional copy highlighting our products, sound-led sessions, and practitioner offerings.



Skills & Requirements:

Proven track record creating engaging content across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



High proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop, Canva and Capicut.



Strong graphic design sense (composition, typography, and visual hierarchy).



Fluent English written communication with a natural flair for warm, grounded storytelling and wellness/reflective concepts.



Experience with social scheduling tools (Later, Buffer, Meta Business Suite) and basic website CMS publishing (e.g., Wix) is a plus.



Highly organised, self-directed, and responsive to feedback.



How to Apply:

Please submit:



A brief introduction outlining your relevant experience.



A link to your portfolio or reel featuring examples of:



Short-form video edits (Reels/TikToks)



Multi-slide carousel designs



Published blog posts or sample copy



Your current availability (hours/week)

title: Client SUCCESS MANAGER
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

title: Community & Operations VA
description:
About The AYCI Academy

The AYCI Academy is the UK's leading coaching programme for NHS doctors preparing for senior consultant job interviews. Founded by Dr Tessa Davis, a paediatric emergency physician, we run five cohorts a year and have helped thousands of doctors secure their first consultant post. We're a small, remote team that operates a tightly structured programme - documented processes, clear ownership, high standards.





The Role

This role is the operational backbone of the AYCI Academy's delivery infrastructure. You'll own the backend systems that keep each cohort running reliably - Circle (our Community Platform) administration, cohort scheduling, 1:1 call logistics, automation monitoring, and the student wins system.



This is not a community management role in the traditional sense. You won't be managing student relationships or driving engagement - that sits with our Student Success Manager. What you'll own is verything behind the scenes: the platform admin, the scheduling, the automations, and the operational accuracy that makes the student-facing experience work.



The standard is simple: nothing slips, nothing needs a follow-up, and our Founder never has to step in because something in this lane was missed.



The role is 15 hours per week at $15/hour. This should include a few hours each day and at least half of these should be during UK hours (can be UK afternoons/evenings)



What You'll Own:

These are the 5 primary areas of work: 



1: Circle Community Administration

You'll own the full backend of our Circle community - setting up cohort spaces, managing access and permissions, uploading recordings, keeping the leaderboard current, and archiving at cohort close. Everything students see in Circle runs through this role.



2: Cohort Scheduling & Logistics

You'll build and maintain the cohort calendar at least a month out - sessions, guest speakers, coaching assignments, and the kickoff sequence. Coaches have what they need before every session. Nothing conflicts with the launch schedule.



3: 1:1 Booking & Call Coordination

End-to-end ownership of all private tier and bonus call bookings. You'll maintain a forward-looking availability calendar and coordinate with coaches to ensure slots always exist before any student is pointed toward a booking link. No booking link goes out without confirmed availability - this is a hard rule.



4: Automation & Systems Monitoring

You'll monitor all active automations in Zapier and Make, own the interview dates system, and keep Kit (ConvertKit) tags and flows running correctly. When something breaks, you catch and fix it. You don't wait to be told.



5: Student Wins System

When a student win comes in through our Student Success Manager, you ensure the backend fires correctly: the right Kit tags, the Boss badge in Circle, automation exclusions, and the testimonial call flow. The wins system is the single source of truth - every win captured, no gaps.





What We're Looking For

- Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through - the kind of person who closes tasks before being asked

- Comfortable working independently in Circle, 
, Zapier/Make, Kajabi, and Kit (ConvertKit) - you don't need to build systems from scratch, but you need to own and maintain them

- Self-directed and high-autonomy - you manage your own board, flag problems early, and don't need daily check-ins

- Clear written English for internal coordination with a small remote team

- Experience supporting a remote online education or membership business is a plus, but not required



This role is not a good fit if you want to work directly with students, prefer flexible undefined scope, or need close direction. We operate with high autonomy and high accountability in equal measure.





How to Apply

- Send your CV and a short Loom (under 3 minutes) covering two things:

1: Why you are the best candidate for this position 

2: One example of a backend operations or admin system you own - what it involves and how you keep it running



We need to know you can do the job.

title: AutoCAD Drafter — Revisions, Markups & As Built Updates
description:
AutoCAD Drafter — Revisions, Markups & As Built Updates



Part-time, with a path to full-time 



This is a CAD drafting role, not a design role. You will be implementing redline/markup changes to

existing Electrical, Hydraulic and Mechanical drawings. Clients send their existing CAD

drawings with mark-ups and redlines — things that need updating, correcting, or bringing up

to date. Your job is to make those changes accurately and quickly in AutoCAD, following the

drawing standard that's already there. It's steady, varied, hands-on CAD drafting work. This is not

designing a project from scratch.



Hours: 16 hours a week to start (approx. 2 - 4 hours/day, 5 days/week — flexible structure available), with the

potential to move to full-time within 6 months based on performance and fit.



Rate: PHP 550 hour

Start: By Negotiation



Arrangement: Direct hire only — no agencies, please. We're also looking for someone who isn't currently

employed full-time with another drafting company or agency, so there's no conflict with our clients' work.



Equipment: You'll need your own PC/laptop, AutoCAD software and a reliable internet connection and power

supply.



About Design Assist Partners

Design Assist Partners P/L has been in business for 21+ years, primarily serving Australian clients. We

specialise in updating and revising existing Electrical, Hydraulic, and Mechanical drawings, plus supporting documentation like Operation & Maintenance (O&M) Manuals. Jobs are typically quoted, drafted, and turned around within days, so you'll be

juggling several small, fast-moving revisions each week rather than living on one project for months at a time.



What you'll be doing

• CAD Drafting: implementing marked-up changes for clients in the construction industry. Job specific training will be offered but strong working knowledge of AutoCAD essential.

•  O&M Manual: assist with the assembly of client data in Microsoft Word and PDF editor. OJT again supplied. 

• Project Deliverables Management. Statements of Work and Job Quotes, completed within four hours;

raising RFI's; monitoring project progress; maintaining a daily Job List and monthly Timesheet/Invoice;

tracking job hours against quoted hours and flagging any drift early; building your own checklists so

your work goes to the client error free.

• Web Research & Lead Generation. Using the internet to assist our direct mail marketing activities.

• Team Contribution (future, as the role grows). Helping train other team members on quality,

timeliness, and project requirements as you take on more responsibility.



What we're looking for

• Hands-on drafting experience executing redline/markup revisions on existing drawings — this is a CAD

Drafter role, not an architect design role.

• A drafting focused background: for example a vocational or technical qualification such as a Bachelor of

Technology (major in Drafting), an Associate's in CAD/Drafting Technology, or equivalent hands-on

training and work experience. We're not looking for a licensed architect or someone building a design

portfolio.

• Comfortable updating Electrical, Hydraulic, and/or Mechanical drawings (prior exposure to any of these

disciplines is a plus).

• Revit/MEP experience is a plus, but not essential.

• Strong written English and solid MS Word/Excel skills for documentation and reporting.

• Comfortable managing your own time, tracking your own hours against quotes, and communicating

proactively rather than waiting to be asked.

• Someone who wants to grow with the role — we're hiring part-time now with a genuine view to full-time

within 6 months for the right person.



How to apply

Please send your resume/CV along with:

• A sample of your drafting work, plus a screenshot of your layer/pen-assignment setup on that drawing

and tell us how you name your layers and why.

• A short note on your current situation: are you currently freelancing, employed elsewhere, or

immediately available? This helps us both make sure the hours and timing work for you.



Why this role

This is a chance to do steady, varied drafting work with a long-established business, with a genuine path to

full-time and more responsibility over time — from production drafting into project coordination, quoting, and

eventually mentoring others on the team.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Close CRM VA
description:
About Us



Team Forbes Riley helps entrepreneurs, coaches, and professionals grow their businesses by learning to sell and pitch with confidence. Our programs include Pitch Like a Pro and Next Level Sales. We recently moved our whole sales operation onto Close CRM, and we need someone to own the system so our SDRs and closers can spend their time selling.



The Role



You will be the go-to person for Close. You'll keep the pipeline clean, keep our automations running, make sure leads don't sit untouched, and give leadership accurate data every week. Our sales team moves fast, so you should like being the organized person behind the scenes who keeps a system running reliably.



What You'll Do



Pipeline hygiene: Keep lead and opportunity records accurate, current, and free of duplicates. Move or close out stalled deals so the pipeline shows only real opportunities.



Lead routing: Make sure leads coming out of SDR Pitch Review calls are routed correctly. A leads go to downsell or nurture, B leads are booked with a closer, and C leads go into objection-handling sequences.

Automations: Monitor, troubleshoot, and adjust nurture sequences, tasks, and workflows. Flag any lead that has gone untouched for three weeks.



Call prep support: Confirm that the Fathom call summaries and AI-generated "Presentation" docs are attached to lead records before closer calls.



Dashboards and reporting: Maintain the sales dashboards and leaderboards, including the Q4 Sales vs. Marketing competition. Prepare weekly performance reports for the Friday team wrap.

Integrations: Keep an eye on the Clarity Pay and Stripe connections and escalate payment or sync issues quickly.



Team support: Answer everyday "how do I…" questions from the sales team, write short how-to guides, and help onboard new SDRs to Close.



Data cleanup: Assist with the remaining migration of active opportunities from old systems.





What We're Looking For



Hands-on experience with Close CRM is strongly preferred. Solid experience with a similar CRM such as HubSpot, 

GoHighLevel, Pipedrive, or Salesforce will also be considered.

Comfort building and editing workflows, sequences, smart views, and custom fields.

Strong attention to detail. You notice when something looks wrong in the data.

Clear, proactive communication. You flag problems before they cost us deals.

Familiarity with sales pipelines, SDR/closer structures, and high-ticket sales processes.

Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours for team meetings.





Bonus Points



Experience with Zapier, Make, or other automation and integration tools

Familiarity with Fathom, Stripe, or payment-financing tools

A background supporting a coaching, education, or info-product business





How to Apply

Send your resume along with a 1 minute loom view about how you've used Close or another CRM to keep a sales team organized. Include one example of an automation or workflow you built and the problem it solved.

title: E-commerce Video Editor & Creative Strategist | AI Experience
description:
We are looking for a skilled E-commerce Video Editor & Creative Strategist who can turn AliExpress products into high-converting video ads from start to finish.



You will often receive only an AliExpress product link. From there, you must independently research the product, competitors, customers, and existing ads, then create the hooks, angles, scripts, content, and finished video ads.

• Write direct-response scripts and d
 the complete video structure

, Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest

AI Advanced Editor.

Love making thumbnails that people can't scroll past? We're hiring a Remote Thumbnail Designer to create bold, high-click-through-rate (CTR) thumbnails that stop the scroll and win the click. Work from anywhere, on a flexible schedule, with clear feedback and real room to grow with us.

Design eye-catching YouTube thumbnails that boost click-through rate (CTR)

Your weekly availability

title: Executive Assistant / Operator
description:
The Role

This is an operations role supporting the CEO of Commerce Road directly. Your job is to keep workflows running smoothly, keep records clean, and make sure deadlines and follow-ups don't get missed.



How This Role Works

You will be directly employed by Commerce Road, but trained and initially supervised by Rare Operations.

In practice, this means you are embedded into one business and one set of priorities, with training and ongoing support from Rare Operations in the background.

1. Commerce Road sets the day-to-day tasks, priorities, and direction

2. Rare Operations trains and initially supervises you on the system, quality, and performance

3. You are assigned to one primary client and focus entirely on their operations



This structure means you work hands-on directly inside Commerce Road's business, backed by the training and quality support of Rare Operations.



Key Responsibilities

1. Filing - keep filing to convention and up to date

2. Investor-report preparation - prepare investor reports accurately and on schedule

3. Receipts transmission - transmit and log receipts promptly

4. General admin - provide general administrative support behind Jordan



Hours and Timezones

8 hours/day, 40 hours per week



Working Hours & Schedule

You will complete an initial training and onboarding programme directly with Rare Operations (approximately 5 hours/day over 2 weeks) before moving to full-time hours on Commerce Road's priorities. Rare Operations remains available on an ongoing basis for troubleshooting, workflow refinement, and operational oversight.



What We're Looking For

We care most about your attitude, ambition, character, and perspective.

You don't need to tick every box below. The interview process is designed to find hard-working, creative, and ambitious candidates. If that's you, let's talk.





Essential:

1. Strong Notion experience - databases, templates, linked views/filters, relations/rollups, and automations

2. Medium proficiency in Excel - for management accounts and data analysis

3. Remote work setup - Your own laptop/computer, reliable internet (minimum 50 Mbps), and a quiet workspace. You must provide your own equipment.

4. Excellent English communication - both written and verbal, with a professional business tone

5. Strong attention to detail - nothing gets past you, and you take pride in accuracy

6. Proactive mindset - you anticipate needs and solve problems before they become issues

7. Technology savvy - comfortable learning new systems and tools quickly

8. Discretion and information management - you will be directly employed by Commerce Road but trained and supervised by Rare Operations, meaning you may have access to commercially sensitive data across both organisations. You must maintain strict confidentiality and keep information separate between the two.



Desirable:

1. A keen interest in system tools and tech - the ability to research, recommend, compare, and contrast the latest tools and tech

2. Previous executive assistant or operations support experience

3. Experience working with UK-based companies or understanding of UK business culture





What We Offer

1. Fully remote role with structured onboarding and training on our Notion operating system

2. A steady flow of varied ops work (admin, Notion, inbox management, bookkeeping support)

3. Clear expectations, regular feedback, and help when something is blocked or unclear

4. Room to grow over time as you build confidence and take on more ownership



Compensation & Benefits

1. £900/month (full-time, 40 hours/week)

2. Performance-based reviews and growth opportunities

3. 24 days paid annual leave





The Application Process

1. Review the full ad.

2. Send your application by filling out this form: rareorigins.notion.site/3e6bcbe40da08056bdcffcd08db04689?pvs=105

3. We will be in touch with long listed candidates to share a bit more about us and confirm your interest in proceeding.

4. We will schedule an initial interview (30 minutes).

5. Final interviews (30-45 minutes) will be scheduled for shortlisted candidates.

6. We will send out Heads of Terms to our preferred candidate and invite you to a three-month probation.



Only applications submitted via the form will be considered.

title: Creative Strategist for Meta Ads - DTC Ecom (A-Players ONLY)
description:
For our Kitchenware brand we’re looking for a Creative Strategist to help us consistently develop high-performing paid social ads, primarily for Meta.



This is a direct-response performance role. You’ll be responsible for understanding why our ads win or lose, developing new creative concepts based on data and customer research, and turning those insights into clear briefs for our editors and creators.



What You’ll Do



- Develop new ad concepts, hooks, angles, and offers

- Write clear creative briefs for video editors, graphic designers and/or creators

- Analyze ad performance and identify winning patterns

- Create iterations of winning ads to help us scale them further

- Research competitors, customer pain points, reviews, and market trends

- Give structured feedback to editors based on performance

- Help maintain an organized creative testing and iteration system



What We’re Looking For



- Experience with DTC/e-commerce creative strategy

- Strong understanding of Meta advertising and direct-response creative

- Ability to analyze metrics such as CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, and hold rate

- Strong copywriting instincts, especially for hooks and ad angles

- Experience writing briefs for editors

- Good understanding of customer psychology and market research

- Comfortable using AI tools for research, ideation, and scripting

- Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple creative tests



Experience with tools such as Trendtrack, Motion, or Foreplay is a plus.



This is not an organic social media or graphic design position. We’re looking for someone focused on creating ads that drive measurable sales.



Why Join Our Team?



You’ll have significant ownership over our creative testing process and will work directly with a fast-growing e-commerce brand where your ideas can quickly translate into measurable results. More importantly, there is space and opportunity to grow into a creative strategy lead as the company grows.



To apply, please include:



- A short overview of your relevant experience

- Examples of ads or creative strategies you’ve worked on

- DTC brands you’ve worked with

- Any performance results you can share

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar & Email Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to email & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and email service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including Email and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $400-$500 USD a month ($4800-$6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: UGC, Content Creator & Strategist - Luxury Travel Brand
description:
UGC Content Creator — Luxury Travel Brand

Part-time to Full-time · Remote · 20–40 hours/week · $7/hour + performance bonuses

Immediate start



ABOUT THE BRAND



We are a luxury travel content brand that just launched. The founder has deep travel experience, a strong personal brand, and a full content library ready to grow. We are looking for one exceptional person to build with us — someone who shows up, pays close attention, and takes ownership without being told twice.



Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube

Content style: Luxury travel, smart travel strategies, real hotel reviews, personal stories

Stage: Active launch — we are in sprint mode and growing fast.



THE ROLE



This is not a task-execution role. We need a creative partner who thinks ahead, catches things others miss, and brings real expertise to the work. You will be writing scripts, producing content, managing platforms, building pitch decks for brand partnerships, and automating workflows using AI.



The founder handles filming, brand decisions, approvals, and deal negotiations. You handle everything else — and you handle it well the first time.



Hours: 20–40 hours per week. Sprint capacity required now.

Schedule: Flexible — but morning and evening EST availability is required.

Rate: $7 USD per hour.

Bonuses: 30-day performance bonus for strong first-month results. Additional bonus tied to the first significant UGC brand deal closed. Both discussed at offer stage.

Growth: Ongoing raises and performance bonuses based on results. This role grows with the brand. The right person grows with it.

Tools provided: Google Workspace, Canva Pro, CapCut — at no cost to you.

Start: Immediate.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1 — Script Writing



Write scripts for Reels and TikToks in the founder's voice — hooks that stop the scroll, storytelling that holds attention, calls to action that convert.

Write outreach scripts and brand pitch narratives for hotel and brand partnerships.

Adapt scripts for different formats — talking head, voiceover, text overlay, carousel flow.

When a script doesn't match the brief or the brand voice — flag it before it gets filmed.



2 — UGC Content Creation & Editing



Edit raw footage into polished Reels — strong hooks, tight pacing, on-brand captions, trending audio.

Design branded carousels and static graphics from approved copy. On-brand, elevated, never generic.

Quick turnaround is non-negotiable. Deliver on time, every time.



3 — Content Operations



Write platform-specific captions for IG, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube in the creator's voice.

Build and maintain content briefs, hashtag banks, and keyword lists.

Schedule and publish content across all platforms.

Build lead magnet PDFs tied to comment keyword triggers.

Submit weekly content ideas in a standard format.



4 — Brand Partnerships & Pitch Decks



Research hotel, resort, and brand partnership opportunities.

Build polished pitch decks and scripts for outreach to US-based brands and properties.

Manage outreach, follow-ups, and partnership pipeline tracking.

Manage brand presence on UGC platforms — Billo, JoinBrands, 
.



5 — AI Automation & Workflow



Use agentic AI tools to automate content scheduling, posting workflows, and repetitive tasks.

This goes beyond using ChatGPT to write captions — you know how to build and run automated workflows.

Document your AI processes so they can be repeated and improved.



6 — Social Media Management



Monitor, respond, and engage across all platforms in the creator's voice.

Track weekly performance metrics and flag what is working and what is not.

Stay current on platform trends, algorithm changes, and trending audio.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



REQUIRED — Script writing experience. You have written scripts for short-form video content — Reels, TikToks, or similar. You understand hooks, pacing, and how to write in someone else's voice.



REQUIRED — Extensive UGC experience. You have created UGC content for real brands, worked on UGC platforms, and have a portfolio that proves it. Not just social media management — actual UGC deliverables. No UGC experience means no consideration.



REQUIRED — US-based client experience. You have worked with US-based clients and understand the market, the platforms, and the pace.



REQUIRED — Pitch deck and pitch script creation. You have built pitch decks and written outreach scripts for brand partnerships or business development.



REQUIRED — Agentic AI fluency. You use AI to build automated workflows, not just to write captions. You can show us specifically how you use it.



Attention to detail — you follow direction the first time. You catch inconsistencies before they become problems. You compare information and flag when something doesn't add up. You will push back and question if something doesn't look right — we want that.

No micromanagement needed — you manage your own workload, ask smart questions, and keep moving without waiting to be nudged.

Proactive communication — you update before you are asked. You never go quiet.

Quick turnaround — fast pace, fast delivery, flexible hours especially in early-stage operations.

Urban / hip hop cultural fluency — you genuinely live in this space. You know what audio is trending before it peaks.

Understanding of the travel industry — you may not have traveled everywhere, but you understand the space. You know the difference between luxury and budget travel, you consume travel content, and you understand what drives booking decisions.

EST morning and evening availability — flexible schedule but responsive during key windows.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



Starting rate: $7 USD per hour

Hours: 20–40 per week

30-day bonus: Performance bonus for strong first-month results — specifics discussed at offer stage.

UGC deal bonus: Bonus tied to the first significant brand partnership deal closed — specifics discussed at offer stage.

Raises: Regular rate reviews based on performance.

Tools: Google Workspace, Canva Pro, CapCut — provided at no cost.



HOW TO APPLY



We read every application carefully. A generic application will not be considered.



Your application must include:



Introduction — Who you are, what you do best, and why this role is the right fit right now.

Script Writing Experience (REQUIRED) — Share an example of a script you wrote for short-form video. What was the hook? What was the call to action?

UGC Experience (REQUIRED) — Tell us specifically what UGC work you have done, which brands you worked with, and what the deliverables were.

US Client Experience (REQUIRED) — Which US-based clients have you worked with and what did you produce for them?

Pitch Deck & Script Experience (REQUIRED) — Have you built pitch decks or written outreach scripts for brand partnerships? Tell us what they were for and share an example if possible.

AI Automation — Tell us specifically how you use agentic AI to automate workflows. Which tools, which processes, what results.

Portfolio — Reel editing, scripts, carousel designs, pitch decks, automated workflows. Links or attachments — no portfolio, no consideration.

The brand question — In 2–3 sentences: what do you think is the single biggest content opportunity for a luxury travel brand right now?

Availability — Confirm you are available to start immediately and have morning and evening EST availability.

Subject line (REQUIRED) — Your subject line must read exactly: Luxury Travel Brand — Content Creator Application. This is your first attention-to-detail test. Applications without this exact subject line will not be reviewed.



Note: A test task will be required as part of the interview process. It is unpaid and takes approximately 1–2 hours. We take this seriously — we expect you to as well.



GREEN FLAGS:



Strong script writing samples — hooks that actually work

Strong UGC portfolio — real brands, real deliverables, real results

US client experience that reflects understanding of the US market

AI automation described in specific, technical terms

You reference the travel industry or luxury travel in your application

You catch something in this posting and mention it — a question, an inconsistency, a detail worth flagging

You go beyond what we asked for



RED FLAGS:



No script writing experience or samples

No UGC experience or portfolio

No US client experience

Never built a pitch deck

Vague AI answers with no specifics

Generic opener with no reference to this role

Took 24+ hours to respond during the application process

Needed to be asked multiple times before addressing feedback



We are building something real in the luxury travel space.

We need someone who catches what others miss — and isn't afraid to say so.

If that's you, we want to hear from you.
salary: $7 per hour + raise and bonus potential

title: Stock Controller- 3PL Warehouses
description:
# Stock Controller – 3PL Warehouses (m/f/d)



**Remote – Philippines | Full-time | Permanent**



## #BEcomeMAXX



You are highly precise, comfortable working with numbers, and not satisfied until every stock difference has been explained?



As **Stock Controller – 3PL Warehouses**, you take ownership of the reconciliation between our external warehouses and SAP Business One. Your goal is simple: **every warehouse movement is correctly reflected in our ERP, every discrepancy is identified, and every open case is followed through until it is closed.**



Working remotely from the Philippines, you will collaborate closely with our Finance, Planning and Purchasing teams in Germany as well as our external 3PL warehouse partners.



You report directly to the **CFO in Germany** and play an important role in ensuring reliable inventory data across IronMaxx.



## Ready to perform? Your tasks with MAXXimum focus



### Daily Stock Control & SAP Booking



- Collect daily goods receipt and inventory reports from our external 3PL warehouses and compare them with planned deliveries in SAP.

- Proactively follow up on missing or delayed warehouse reports.

- Reconcile every purchase order line against the actual warehouse receipt, including **item, quantity, batch and best-before date**.

- Post Goods Receipt POs accurately in **SAP Business One**, including delivery note references and supporting documentation.

- Reconcile warehouse-to-warehouse transfers and ensure that quantities leaving one location are correctly received at the destination.

- Compare outbound shipments and customer returns reported by our warehouses with deliveries recorded in SAP.

- Ensure that inventory movements are documented completely and traceably.



### Difference & Clarification Management



- Identify stock, receipt and shipment discrepancies and transfer unresolved quantities into the designated clarification warehouse in SAP.

- Assign the correct reason code and maintain a structured log of every open case.

- Follow up with 3PL warehouses on discrepancies within **24 hours**.

- Follow up with suppliers within **48 hours** where supplier clarification is required.

- Request invoice corrections where received quantities differ from invoiced quantities.

- Track every discrepancy from identification through to final resolution.

- Provide a daily status update to Accounts Payable, Purchasing and the CFO.



### Weekly Inventory Reconciliation



- Perform a complete reconciliation of each 3PL warehouse against SAP by **item, quantity, batch and best-before date**.

- Investigate and explain all inventory differences.

- Review the clarification warehouse and document the **age, reason, owner and next action** for every open item.

- Identify partially delivered and overdue purchase orders and provide the Planning team with a clear recommendation to **close or keep open**.

- Maintain warehouse performance scorecards covering:

  - Report timeliness

  - Inventory differences

  - Open clarification cases

  - Resolution performance



### Month-End & Inventory Reporting



- Prepare the month-end stock reconciliation for each external warehouse.

- Support year-end stock confirmations and provide documentation required for financial audits.

- Support physical inventory counts and cycle counts performed by our warehouse partners.

- Identify unresolved stock cases older than **30 days** and prepare recommendations for claims, corrections or write-offs.

- Prepare the monthly inventory and reconciliation KPI pack for the CFO.

- Maintain and continuously improve the related SOPs and step-by-step procedures.



## Your impact – what success looks like



### Within your first 4 weeks



You independently manage the daily reconciliation process for all assigned external warehouses.



### Within your first 3 months



You achieve:



- **≥95%** of warehouse receipts posted by the next working day after arrival

- **≥90%** of inventory discrepancies resolved within 48 hours

- **≥99.5%** stock-line accuracy during weekly warehouse-to-SAP reconciliation

- Clear ownership and documented next steps for all remaining open clarification cases



## MAXXimum qualifications – what you bring



- At least **3 years of professional experience** in inventory control, stock reconciliation, warehouse administration, inventory accounting or Accounts Payable with three-way matching.

- Hands-on experience working with an ERP system. **SAP Business One is strongly preferred**, but experience with SAP, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics or comparable systems is also suitable.

- Very good written and spoken **English**.

- Confident professional communication with suppliers and logistics partners – clear, polite and persistent when follow-up is required.

- Advanced **Microsoft Excel** skills, including:

  - XLOOKUP

  - SUMIFS

  - Pivot Tables

  - Data cleaning and reconciliation

- Power Query experience is an advantage.

- Good understanding of warehouse and inventory processes such as:

  - Inbound receiving

  - Putaway

  - Warehouse transfers

  - Batch management

  - FEFO

  - Blocked stock

  - Returns

  - Cycle counts

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to trace a quantity through the complete process from **Purchase Order → Delivery Note → Warehouse Receipt → SAP Booking → Supplier Invoice**.

- A structured and disciplined working style with strong ownership of open cases.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating with international teams.



## Nice to have



- Practical SAP Business One experience, especially with:

  - Goods Receipt PO

  - Inventory Transfers

  - Batch Management

- Previous experience in **FMCG, food, sports nutrition or supplements**.

- Experience working directly with **third-party logistics providers (3PLs)**.

- Familiarity with European logistics and shipping documentation such as **delivery notes and CMRs**.



## Why IronMaxx?



- A long-term, full-time remote position with an international **sports nutrition and fitness brand**.

- Structured onboarding with clear SOPs and step-by-step procedures.

- SAP Business One training and a structured parallel run with the existing team.

- Direct collaboration with Finance and Supply Chain leadership in Germany.

- High ownership and direct visibility of the impact of your work.

- An international working environment with colleagues across Europe and the Philippines.

- A Philippines-based team that you become part of from day one.



**Ready to bring structure, accuracy and transparency to our international inventory operations?**



Then join IronMaxx and help us make sure that every unit, every batch and every warehouse movement is exactly where it should be.



**#BEcomeMAXX**

title: Performance Manager — Meta Ads & Onboarding (Remote)
description:
⚠️ IMPORTANT — READ FIRST Applying on this platform does NOT count as an application. To be considered, you must apply here: 👉 
 



Applications without a video submission will not be considered.



About Social Hotspot

We're a UK-based growth agency helping trades businesses — bathrooms, kitchens, windows — generate qualified leads and book appointments through a done-for-you marketing system called GrowthSuite.



We've generated £25M+ for our partners. We're trusted by 80+ active businesses. And we're on a mission to hit £100M in sales for UK trades businesses. We're growing fast and we need the right people to grow with us.

About The Role

This is not a senior media buyer role with a nicer title.



You own the performance of every ad account we run — around 120 accounts across three client pods — through a team of three Media Buyers and three Onboarding VAs, and you report directly to our founder. Two numbers sit above everything else on your scorecard: total churn and average client satisfaction score. Everything else in the role exists to move those two numbers.



The standard here: you should know the ad accounts better than the media buyers do. That comes from inspecting the actual work — accounts, builds, tickets — twice a week, every week. Not from reading a report at month end.



Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00–17:30 (UK time). Fully remote, full-time.

What You'll Be Doing

Running two full passes of every ad account each week — worst client score first, with red accounts taken apart line by line: copy, headline, targeting, offer, landing page, survey

Checking every client onboarding build within a day of completion — the media buyer's campaign setup and the VA's GoHighLevel build — looking for mistakes, not ticked boxes

Logging every finding with one clear change, and checking at the next pass that the change actually happened

Running weekly ad account coaching calls and weekly 1:1s with each media buyer, and weekly 1:1s with each VA

Sweeping every internal support channel and client WhatsApp group twice a week — and re-testing "resolved" issues yourself

Running a post-mortem within 48 hours on every account that churns or stays red for 30 days

Owning the at-risk list, attending the twice-weekly red flag meeting, and running weekly and monthly reviews with the founder

Grading your team monthly and running their bonus process

Hiring, onboarding, and — when it's the right call — exiting media buyers and VAs

Owning every media buyer and VA SOP, their ramp-up courses and the GoHighLevel course, on a rolling three-month audit

What You Must Be Strong At

Meta ads diagnosis — you can open an account you've never seen and find what's wrong in minutes

Coaching — getting a buyer to see the problem themselves, landing one change, and following up until the behaviour changes

Attention to detail at volume — 120 accounts, six people, every build checked, nothing skipped

GoHighLevel — landing pages, forms, automations, custom values and AI bots, well enough to catch someone else's mistakes

Commercial awareness — you understand lead quality, show rates and churn, not just CPL

Composure delivering hard news — to your team, and upward to the founder

Accountability — you own the team's numbers like they're your own business

Compensation

£3,250/month base salary (£39,000/year, approx. $4,300/month), plus monthly bonuses:



£250/month when total churn is 5% or under

£250/month when average client satisfaction score is 8.1+

£100/month when every client in their first 90 days is on pace to 45+ appointments

£15 for every ad account that was in the red zone at the end of last month and is out of it at the end of this month



No bonus is paid in any month where your own overall grade falls below a B — the account passes, the build checks and the 1:1s are the price of entry to the variable, not optional extras.



On-target earnings: roughly £45,500–£49,000 a year.

Your KPIs

Total churn — A grade: under 3%

Average client satisfaction score — A grade: 8.1+/10

% of clients in RED on CPL — A grade: 0–5%

Clients in their first 90 days on pace to 45+ appointments — A grade: every client on pace

Onboarding SOPs completed on time (team) — A grade: all

Onboarding accuracy, revisions required (team) — A grade: 0–2/month

IT issues resolved on time (team) — A grade: 95%+

Ad tracker and R&D compliance (team) — A grade: all buyers hit both

Ad account passes completed — A grade: all 8 in the month

Grading accuracy vs the founder's spot-check — A grade: no disagreements

Cadence delivered on time (1:1s, ad account calls, red flags, scorecards) — A grade: all on time

SOP revisions cleared in the month due — A grade: all

Ramp-ups passed on schedule — A grade: all at 90%+, on time

Documented mistakes (all types) — A grade: 0–2/month



Requirements

Fluent English (written and spoken)

5+ years running Meta ads, with $500,000+ in proven ad spend managed

Local lead generation experience — home improvement strongly preferred

Agency experience managing a multi-client portfolio

Experience checking, training or managing other media buyers' work

Hands-on GoHighLevel — funnels, forms, automations

Comfortable with 
 (or similar), Google Sheets and dashboards

Available 9:00–17:30 UK time, Monday to Friday

Full-time and exclusive — no other clients, agencies or side projects



Bonus Skills

A formal team lead or management role over media buyers

Experience running a grading or bonus scheme

Power BI

Writing SOPs or training material



Who This Is For



Someone who's the best media buyer in the room and wants to make everyone else in it better. Someone who'd rather find the red account on Monday morning than hear about it from a client on Friday. Someone who can tell a colleague their work isn't good enough — and check the next week that it changed. Someone who wants to own the numbers, not just their own accounts.



Who This Is NOT For

Anyone who manages from a dashboard instead of opening the accounts. Anyone who quietly fixes other people's mistakes instead of telling them. Anyone who avoids hard conversations. Freelancers juggling other clients. Anyone who needs to be told what "good" looks like instead of building the standard themselves.







How to Apply

To be considered, you must apply here: 👉 
 



As part of your application, submit a Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering:



Who you are, the ad spend you've managed and the results you've got

A time you raised someone else's performance — trained them, checked their work or managed them — and what changed

Why you're the right person for this role



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: 3D Rendering Specialist
description:
LiLi Tile is looking for a talented 3D Rendering Specialist to create realistic, high-quality visualizations of kitchens, bathrooms, commercial spaces, and more using our signature tile designs. Work on your own time, from anywhere in the world—we pay per completed render and host exciting monthly contests to reward creative excellence.

- Rate: 3,500 PHP per rendering

- Contests: Monthly challenges with prizes up to 18,500 PHP (rules and themes vary)

- Schedule: 100% flexible—work when it suits you



What You’ll Do:

- Use 3D design software to produce photorealistic scenes showcasing LiLi Tile products

- Follow clear, creative briefs and moodboard-style references

- Accept and incorporate feedback for revisions when needed

- Deliver polished, publish-ready images that highlight style, layout, and atmosphere



 Requirements:

- Proficiency in rendering software such as 3ds Max, V-Ray, SketchUp, Blender, or similar

- Strong sense of composition, lighting, and design detail

- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively

- A portfolio that demonstrates rendering ability and style range



What You Get:

- Flexible Work: You choose when and how often you work

- Performance Bonuses: Earn more during promos and monthly design contests

- Consistent Feedback: Quick team reviews to help elevate your work

- Fast Payments: Paid every two weeks via PayPal



How to Apply:

- To apply, please send us your portfolio or sample renderings showcasing interior scenes. Applications without visual examples will not be considered.

- If we’re impressed by your portfolio, we’ll invite you to complete a short test task to evaluate fit and skill alignment. This helps us ensure the best collaboration moving forward.



We’re excited to see your creative take on our tiles!

title: Business Development Sales — Commercial & Multifamily Facility Services**
description:
**Business Development Sales — Commercial & Multifamily Facility Services**

**CPR Consulting | Remote**



CPR Consulting manages property maintenance, unit turns, cleaning, painting, paving, roofing, HVAC and plumbing for commercial and multifamily properties.



We’re hiring an experienced Business Development Sales to help us win new property-management and facility-services accounts. Your job is to identify the right buyers, start relevant conversations and turn interest into qualified meetings and quote opportunities.



**Responsibilities**



* Research property-management companies, commercial properties and facility managers within our service areas.

* Identify decision-makers, vendor-onboarding requirements and upcoming service needs.

* Run personalized
 outreach and follow-up campaigns using research and automation tools.

* Develop referral opportunities through clients, vendors and industry contacts.

* Complete supplier applications and follow through to reach the person assigning work.

* Manage responses, qualify opportunities and schedule calls or walkthroughs for our team.

* Coordinate with our PMs on quote follow-ups and next steps.

* Maintain an accurate pipeline showing contacts, needs, activity, ownership and deadlines.

* Report weekly on qualified meetings held, quote opportunities and accounts won.



**What we’re looking for**



* Demonstrated B2B lead-generation or appointment-setting experience.

* Experience with property management, commercial cleaning, construction or facility services strongly preferred.

* Strong written English and confidence communicating with U.S. business contacts.

* Experience with a CRM, prospect-research tools and
 automation.

* Ability to use AI to improve research and personalization while checking accuracy.

* Reliable follow-through and availability overlapping U.S. Eastern business hours.



Our leadership and PM team handle technical scoping, pricing approval and closing. You own prospecting, qualification and follow-up.



**Success means reaching relevant decision-makers and creating real opportunities for paid work. Contact lists and
 volume alone are not success measures.**



**To apply, send:**



1. Your resume and requested hourly rate.

2. Your availability in U.S. Eastern time.

3. One example of a B2B campaign you personally managed, including results.

4. A brief explanation of how you would secure CPR’s first meeting with a new property-management company.

5. The research, CRM and automation tools you have used.

title: Video Editor for Real Estate (Singapore) - Shorts/Reels
description:
We are looking for a dedicated, seasoned Video Editor with a proven track record of executing engaging, high-retention videos.



We are a stable, established boutique Singapore-based real estate team. You will be working directly with a top-performing real estate agent, helping her turn a large volume of raw footage into polished, daily content.



Students need not apply. We are looking for a mature, career-oriented professional who wants to build a long-term career with a growing company, not someone looking for a temporary gig.



The Role:

As a Full-Time Video Editor, you will be responsible for producing high-quality video content that aligns with our brand's vision.



She has a large backlog of raw footage. To start, your primary KPI will be to edit, deliver, and post one captivating short video per day (10-60 seconds) directly to her social platforms. In addition to the daily shorts, you will also be required to edit occasional long-form videos (e.g., property tours or deep dives) as needed.



Please note: The goal is ultimately a higher output. We are starting you at one short video a day so you can get used to the workflow, but you should expect the daily target to scale up to two short videos per day (plus the occasional long-form video) in the coming months. We need someone who is ready to handle that volume once fully onboarded.



We aren't looking for over-the-top Hollywood effects—we need clean, engaging edits with good pacing, dynamic captions, and smooth punch-ins/zooms to keep the viewer hooked.



Responsibilities:

• Take raw talking-head and property footage and edit it into 1 (eventually 2) high-quality short videos per day, plus occasional long-form videos. 

• Act as her social media publisher: you will be fully responsible for uploading, writing captions, scheduling, and posting the finalized videos on her behalf across her platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube). 

• Enhance videos with engaging text/captions, zoom ins/outs, sound effects, and clean transitions to maximize retention. 

• Review and select the best shots from raw footage, removing dead air and mistakes. 

• Incorporate feedback and revisions quickly and efficiently. 

• Stay up to date with video trends, audio, and best practices across all platforms.



Requirements:

• Proven work experience as a Video Editor (experience with both short-form vertical content and standard long-form horizontal content is highly preferred). 

• Minimum 3+ years of professional experience (we are looking for a reliable, seasoned professional). 

• Proficiency in video editing software (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut Pro, or similar tools). 

• Strong understanding of pacing, hook creation, and visual aesthetics for social media. 

• Ability to work independently, manage a daily content pipeline, and deliver projects strictly on deadline. 

• A stable internet connection and the necessary hardware to process video efficiently. 

• Attention to detail test: Please include the exact phrase "Reels Superhero" in the first line of your application so we know you took the time to read through these requirements.



Location:

This is a remote position based in the Philippines.



Application Process:

Send EXACTLY 5 links (not more, not less) to your best video edits. Please include at least one short-form video and, if possible, one long-form video (optional). 

Please do not include irrelevant videos like wedding highlights or personal vlogs. We only want to see your ability to edit engaging, high-retention content.

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a further assessment and interview.



We look forward to reviewing your creative work!

title: Part-Time Advanced TikTok Shop Video Editor – Long-Term + Bonuses

COMPENSATION & GROWTH

• Up to €100/month performance bonus (€600 total / €6.92/hour)

BLUE MANGO

BLUE MANGO – Video Editor Application

We look forward to reviewing your application and hopefully getting to know you better.

title: Proofreader/Fact-Checker
description:
Position: Proofreader / Fact-Checker 

About us

Arch of the High Sierras is a fifteen-year-old family business located in Reno, Nevada. We specialize in making a wide variety of quality wall calendars. While our calendars serve a practical purpose, we hope that they also bring some beauty, inspiration, and laughter into people’s lives. 



We’re currently building our 2028 line and expect to produce about 1,000 unique calendar titles across a wide range of subjects, including nature, travel, pets, and inspiration.



We're seeking a detail-oriented full-time Proofreader/Fact-Checker to verify image information and polish calendars before sending files to our printer. This is a remote position, 40 hours per week, with a salary commensurate with experience. 



Responsibilities

Fact-checking 

- Verify the accuracy of photographer-supplied location information and animal species (both common and scientific names) for stock images from companies such as Alamy and DepositPhotos.

- Use online reference tools and search engines (including AI tools) to confirm:

City, region, and country for travel and nature images.

Correct common and scientific names for wildlife images.

Ensure species names follow CMOS style (for example, capitalization, italics, and ordering of common vs. scientific name).

- Flag any images where the location or species seems incorrect or uncertain, and add notes or reference links for our team to review.

-Follow our captioning style and update captions as needed for clarity and consistency.



Proofreading

-Proofread calendar pages (covers, monthly grids, back covers) for:

- Spelling, grammar, and punctuation.

- Consistency of style, terminology, and capitalization across related calendars.

- A quick visual review to ensure dates and holidays appear correct (we work from vetted templates, so you only need to flag anything that looks obviously wrong or out of place).

- Color accuracy and coordination, including checking that each month’s color palette matches and complements that month’s image.

- Record all edits clearly for our graphic designers using comments in Google Sheets.

- Collaborate with the in-house editing team and graphic designers to follow existing voice and style guidelines.



Requirements

- Proven experience as a proofreader, copy editor, or fact-checker, ideally in publishing, marketing, or educational content.

- Excellent command of written English, strong editorial judgment, and fluent English communication skills for working with a global team.

- High accuracy and attention to detail, including the ability to review your own work to correct typos and confirm that requested edits have been made.

- Strong online research skills and familiarity with reliable sources for geography and animals.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects at once, and meet daily deadlines.

- Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain consistency across many related projects.

- Critical thinker who can choose the best approach or solution for each project.

- Team player who communicates proactively and collaborates well with remote colleagues.

- Comfortable working in tools such as Slack, Toggl, Google Sheets & Docs, and PDFs.

- Willingness to use AI-assisted research tools for initial lookups (training and process guidelines provided).



Nice to have

- Background or strong interest in geography, travel, animals, or nature photography.

- Experience working with stock image companies (for example, Alamy, Depositphotos).

- Prior experience with calendar or book production.



Compensation and schedule

- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- A 4-hour overlap with U.S. business hours is required; the standard start time is 5:00 a.m. Philippine time, with some flexibility by agreement.

- Salary commensurate with experience.

- Remote role; strong, reliable internet and contingency plans for both connectivity and electricity are required.



How to apply

Please include:

- A brief introduction explaining your proofreading and/or fact-checking experience.

- Examples of relevant work (or a short portfolio).

- Your CV.

- Your current location and typical working hours.



Selection process

- After reviewing your CV and portfolio, if we’d like to proceed with the interview process, we’ll send you a few trial tasks. This practical step is designed to give you an idea of the scope of work and help us evaluate your approach to determine if it fits our team’s needs.

- If selected to continue, you’ll have a video interview with two staff members.

title: Virtual Assistant — Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography
description:
Working with Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography means becoming an important part of a luxury wedding photography and cinematography team. The role is highly organized, client-focused, and requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to keep multiple weddings and deadlines moving forward.



💍 Client Communication & Lead Management



- Respond to potential wedding clients through Zola and other inquiry platforms.

- Respond to inquiries promptly, professionally, and warmly.

- Answer basic questions about our photography and cinematography services, packages, availability, and next steps.

- Follow up with potential clients who have not responded.

- Keep client information and communication organized and up to date.



📋 Managing Booked Wedding Clients



- Maintain communication with couples throughout the planning process.

- Send and track wedding questionnaires and make sure they are completed on time.

- Follow up with clients when important information or forms are outstanding.

- Schedule final consultations with couples before their wedding.

- Obtain and organize the couple's finalized wedding timeline.

- Review timelines for missing or important information and communicate anything that needs clarification to the photography/cinematography team.

- Keep track of important wedding dates, deadlines, and client tasks.

- Send reminders as needed so clients stay on schedule.



📅 Wedding Workflow & Organization



- Maintain an organized system for upcoming weddings and their associated tasks.

- Track which clients have completed questionnaires, consultations, payments, timelines, and other required items.

- Keep track of assigned photographers and videographers for each wedding, including their availability, assignments, and any changes to coverage or staffing.

- Scout and vet photographers and cinematographers who may be a good fit to join the Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography team.

- Research potential photographers and cinematographers through portfolios, websites, social media, and other professional platforms.

- Help coordinate initial outreach, collect portfolios/resumes, and organize candidate information for review.

- Help ensure nothing falls through the cracks as a wedding approaches.

- Coordinate information between clients and the photography/cinematography team.

- Flag important issues or time-sensitive items to management.



🎬 Post-Wedding Client Management



- Communicate with our photo and video editors regarding the status of wedding galleries and films.

- Track editing progress and expected completion dates.

- Follow up with editors when deadlines are approaching or additional information is needed.

- Keep clients informed regarding the expected timeframe for their deliverables.

- Respond to client questions regarding gallery, film, highlight video, album, and other deliverable timelines.

- Proactively communicate updates to clients rather than waiting for them to ask.

- Monitor completed deliverables and ensure they are sent to clients in a timely manner.

- Follow up on outstanding post-wedding items until the client's project is fully completed.



📧 Client Experience



- Provide a friendly, professional, and reassuring experience from the initial inquiry through final delivery.

- Maintain the warm, personal communication style that Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography is known for.

- Help clients feel that their wedding is being actively managed and that they have someone available to assist them.

- Handle routine questions independently while knowing when to escalate something to Garrett or management.



⭐ What We're Looking For



- Excellent written and verbal communication.

- Strong organization and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple weddings and deadlines simultaneously.

- Comfortable communicating with clients and vendors professionally.

- Reliable and responsive, especially when dealing with time-sensitive client requests.

- Comfortable using
, calendars, spreadsheets, CRM/client-management systems, and online wedding platforms.

- Ability to follow established workflows while also recognizing when something needs attention.

- Someone who takes ownership of tasks rather than simply waiting to be told what to do.



Overall Role



The goal of this position is to help make sure every client is taken care of from the first inquiry through final delivery. The VA will serve as an important organizational and communication link between potential clients, booked couples, photographers, cinematographers, editors, and the Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography team.



The ideal person will be proactive, organized, personable, and comfortable keeping track of many moving pieces while ensuring that clients consistently receive timely communication and a high level of service.

title: Amazon Seller Central Inventory Control Specialist

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Seller Central Inventory Control Specialist to manage inventory accuracy, replenishment, and stock movement across our Amazon operations.



Responsibilities:

1) Monitor inventory levels, low-stock alerts, stranded inventory, excess inventory, and stock-outs.

2) Plan and create FBA replenishment shipments.

3) Track inbound shipments, stock coverage, sell-through, and restock timelines.

4) Maintain accurate inventory trackers across Amazon, warehouses, and internal systems.

5) Reconcile inventory discrepancies between Amazon and warehouse records.

6) Investigate lost, damaged, unfulfillable, stranded, and receiving discrepancy cases.

7) Submit and follow up on eligible Amazon reimbursement claims.

8) Coordinate with warehouse and operations teams to ensure stock is prepared and shipped on time.

9) Prepare inventory, replenishment, and discrepancy reports.

10) Follow inventory SOPs and improve processes to reduce stock-outs and errors.
