2) Experience with FBA replenishment, shipment creation, inventory reconciliation, stranded inventory, and reimbursement cases.

3) Good understanding of Amazon inventory reports and inbound shipment workflows.

4) Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and inventory trackers.

5) Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a large number of SKUs accurately.

6) Good written English and communication skills.

7) Experience with NetSuite, ShipStation, or warehouse systems is preferred.

8) Experience managing North American Amazon accounts is preferred.

title: Amazon Vendor Central Coordinator
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon Vendor Central Coordinator to manage our Vendor Central operations.



Responsibilities:

1) Manage daily Amazon Vendor Central activities.

2) Process and monitor purchase orders, confirmations, shipments, shortages, cancellations, and invoices.

3) Track ASNs, routing requests, freight, and delivery compliance.

4) Investigate, dispute, and follow up on chargebacks, shortages, and invoice discrepancies.

5) Coordinate with warehouses, suppliers, freight partners, and internal teams.

6) Monitor listing, item setup, catalogue, and retail readiness issues.

7) Maintain accurate operational and inventory trackers.

8) Prepare weekly reports on purchase orders, fulfilment performance, chargebacks, and stock.

9) Follow SOPs and recommend process improvements.



Requirements:

1) At least 2 years of hands-on Amazon Vendor Central experience.

2) Strong knowledge of purchase orders, ASNs, routing, shortages, chargebacks, and invoicing.

3) Experience coordinating with warehouses, suppliers, or freight partners.

4) Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

5) Good written English and communication skills.

6) Detail-oriented, organised, and able to meet deadlines independently.

7) Experience with North American Amazon marketplaces is preferred.

title: Senior Catalogue & InDesign Design Coordination Specialist
description:

(Full-Time Contract – 4 Months)

This role requires strong judgement, structure, and the ability to independently manage a complex, multi-stakeholder catalogue project.



Catalogue Scope:



Approximately 500 pages



20+ categories of hardware tools



Adobe InDesign master files

Full-time: 4-month contract

Clean, logically organised InDesign files and assets delivered on time



Ideal Candidate Profile



Advanced proficiency in Adobe InDesign (essential)



Proven experience handling large, complex catalogues or multi-page print publications



Strong understanding of print production workflows



Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision



Confident liaising with customers and external vendors



Highly detail-oriented with strong organisational discipline



Experience with hardware, industrial, or technical product catalogues is a strong advantage



How to Apply (OnlineJobs.ph)



Please apply via OnlineJobs.ph and include:



Updated resume / CV



Portfolio demonstrating:



Large-scale catalogues



Multi-page InDesign publications



Print-ready layout work



A brief note highlighting:



Your experience managing complex catalogue projects



Your availability for a full-time, 4-month contract starting 05 January 2026



Applications without relevant InDesign catalogue samples will not be considered.

title: Senior Video Editor Role
description:
Senior Video Editor & YouTube Growth Specialist

SynxBody  ·  Dumaguete, Philippines (office-based)  ·  Full-time, 40 hrs/week  ·  PHP 40,000–60,000/month



We are an Australian brand committed to helping people move, feel and live better through footcare, compression and wellness products. We’re building a content engine across YouTube, TikTok and founder-led video that doesn’t just inform it keeps people watching. We need an editor who thinks like a creator first: someone who studies retention graphs the way most editors study transitions.

This isn’t a cut-and-trim role. You’ll take raw footage and turn it into the kind of content that grows a channel, not just fills it.

What success looks like



Twelve months in, you’re a big part of why our YouTube watch time and subscriber count are climbing quarter over quarter. Our Shorts and TikToks are a second content engine, not an afterthought. The founder trusts you to push back on a weak hook or a bloated intro, because you’ve proven you know what keeps people watching.



What you’ll do

• Edit long-form YouTube videos with strong story arcs, retention-focused pacing, and hooks built to survive the first 15 seconds

• Repurpose long-form into high-performing Shorts, Reels and TikToks, tuned to each platform 

• Edit founder-led content, product education videos and customer stories

• Add motion graphics, sound design, colour grading and captions that match the brand

• Review YouTube analytics and retention graphs to sharpen the next edit, not just the last one

• Pitch thumbnail concepts, titles and content ideas in planning sessions — you execute

• 4+ years editing for YouTube, with real retention or watch-time results you can show

• Fluent in Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop and CapCut; DaVinci Resolve is a plus

• Strong grasp of story structure, pacing and hook-writing — not just technical cutting

• Comfortable editing short-form for TikTok, Reels and Shorts at volume without losing brand identity

• Experience with colour correction, sound design, audio cleanup and kinetic typography

Nice to have

• Experience growing a YouTube channel, not just editing for one

• Thumbnail design, photography or videography skills

• Background working with creators, influencers or founder-led brands

• An interest in health, wellness or consumer behaviour

• AI-assisted editing workflow knowledge

Compensation

PHP 40,000–60,000/month, full-time (40 hrs/week), office-based in Dumaguete.

How to apply

Send: your portfolio, 2–3 YouTube videos you’ve edited (before/after if you have them), any channels you’ve helped grow, your favourite YouTube creator and why, and a 60-second video introducing yourself.

We’re looking for someone who sees themselves as a content creator first and an editor second. If that’s you, we want to hear from you.

title: Product Coordinator
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Coordinator who will serve as the main point of contact for product-related projects across different departments



The Product Coordinator will help keep projects organized, ensure information is properly communicated between teams, monitor timelines and deliverables, and follow up on action items. This role is focused on coordination, communication, documentation, and project tracking than directly developing or launching products.



You will work closely with management and different departments to make sure everyone involved in a product project is aligned and that tasks move forward according to the agreed timeline.



 Key Responsibilities:



-Serve as the main point of contact for product-related projects across departments.

-Coordinate communication between teams involved in product development and launch activities.

 -Create and maintain project timelines, task lists, trackers, and status updates.

-Coordinate with different departments to gather information and requirements needed for product projects.

-Assign or coordinate action items with the appropriate team members based on project requirements.

-Follow up on pending tasks, deliverables, approvals, and deadlines.

-Monitor overall project progress and make sure tasks are moving according to schedule.

- Identify delays, missing information, dependencies, or issues and escalate them to the appropriate manager or leadership.

- Keep all teams updated on changes, decisions, deadlines, and next steps.

- Organize and maintain product-related documents, files, references, and project records.

- Coordinate meetings or project discussions when needed and document important decisions and action items.

-Prepare regular project status updates for management.

-Help ensure that departments understand their responsibilities and deadlines for each project.

- Coordinate handoffs between departments to ensure a smooth workflow.

- Help improve the company's product coordination and project management processes.

 -Perform other coordination and administrative tasks related to product projects as assigned.



Departments You May Coordinate With

Depending on the project, you may work closely with:



-Product / Product Development

- Marketing

-Sales

-E-commerce / Marketplace Teams

 -Operations

- Supply Chain

-Customer Service

- Creative / Design

- Finance

-Management



 What We're Looking For:



-At least 1–2 years of experience in project coordination, product coordination, operations, e-commerce, or a similar role.

-Strong organizational and project management skills.

-Excellent follow-up and communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

-Able to manage multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously.

-Comfortable coordinating with different departments and personalities.

-Proactive in following up and identifying potential delays or issues.

 -Able to communicate clearly and professionally in written and verbal communication.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

-Strong documentation and tracking skills.

-Proficient with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.

-Willing and able to learn project management and collaboration tools.



Qualifications

Experience with any of the following is a plus:



- Product development or product coordination

-Project management

-E-commerce

- Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart, or other marketplaces

-Asana or similar project management tools

 -Working with cross-functional teams

-Consumer products, collectibles, TCG, gaming, or related industries





How to Apply

Please submit:



1. Your updated resume/CV

2. A brief summary of your experience in project coordination, product coordination, or cross-department coordination

3. Examples of projects you have coordinated, if applicable



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Client Relationship Manager | No Graveyard Shift - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a proactive client leadership role focused on driving long-term results and retention.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success in this role is driven by strong client retention, consistent communication, proactive account management, and client progress.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Your raise to USD 2,000/month is based on performance and is reviewed after your first 30–60 days upon passing quality standards.



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Block 1 (Client Hours): 6:00 AM – 12:00 PM PH Time (Mon–Fri)

- Block 2 (Team Meetings): 9:00 PM – 11:00 PM PH Time (Specific weekdays)

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

It adds a branded inspection report generator, an estimator and proposal builder, and job costing.

A HighLevel template that sets up contractor accounts: pipelines, custom fields, forms, calendars, workflows and message templates.

Our core web platform. A property and job record system with:

a mobile-first, offline-capable field app for technicians (photos, readings, checklists)

warranty registration and a review queue

dealer ordering and a certification portal

an internal admin dashboard

Lead-generation tools. An instant roof and basement estimator widget, data-driven property lists, and integrations with mapping and property-data APIs.

TypeScript, React, Node.js

HighLevel API and Marketplace modules

REST APIs and webhooks

Cloudflare, Vercel or similar hosting

AI coding tools daily: Claude Code, Cursor or similar

) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.

You'll build our hiring system from the ground up. You'll recruit for both our remote team (developers, engineers, sales and marketing roles) and our Dutch team, and you'll own what happens after the contract is signed too: onboarding and performance reviews.



There is no existing process to take over. There's a handful of vacancy texts, an onboarding guide, and a lot of know-how in people's heads. Your job is to turn that into a system that works without anyone chasing it every day.



- Build the pipeline: sourcing, screening, interview flow, and offers, end-to-end

- Write and post vacancies: on LinkedIn, job boards, and local channels, for local and Dutch candidates

- Source actively: especially senior developers and engineers who aren't actively looking

- Screen candidates: review video applications and run first screening calls

- Coordinate interviews: plan interviews and technical assessments with our Head of Technology and team leads

- Set up the tooling: an applicant tracking system, kept clean and up to date

- Own onboarding: accounts, access, a first-week plan, and making sure a new hire is productive fast

- Run performance reviews: set up a review cycle together with leadership and keep it running

- Report on hiring: open roles, pipeline, time to hire, and where candidates drop off

- Support operations: help with our ISO 27001 work and keeping track of legislation that affects how we work



Recruitment, onboarding and reviews are the core. The rest of the scope will take shape as the role grows, so expect some variety.



What We're Looking For



Must-Have Skills:

- 3+ years recruitment experience, ideally in tech or IT

- Experience sourcing developers and technical profiles

- You can tell a strong engineer from a strong CV, and you know which questions to ask

- Experience setting up or improving a hiring, onboarding, or HR process

- Excellent English communication (written and verbal)

- Organized and reliable: you follow up without being asked



Nice-to-Have Skills:

- Experience recruiting for international or remote teams

- Experience with Dutch candidates or the Dutch job market

- ATS experience (Teamtailor, Recruitee, Workable, or similar)

- LinkedIn Recruiter

 -Experience running performance reviews

- Experience with ISO 27001, compliance documentation, or HR-related legislation

- Notion, Google Workspace, Slack



AI tools are welcome:

We're an AI company. If you use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to write vacancies, screen CVs, prepare interviews, or build your own recruiting workflows, tell us how. We'd rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What We Offer:

- Long-term partnership: we're investing in your future with us

- Build something from zero: you design how MSTR hires, onboards, and grows people

- Direct impact: every hire you make shapes the team for years

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



How to Apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please DO NOT apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a Short Video (3-7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:

1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into recruitment.

2. A hard-to-fill role: Tell us about a role you struggled to fill. Where did you look, how did you find the right person, and how did you know they were right?

About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products. Most of what we build runs on Azure, on AI Foundry, and on Claude.



Our clients trust us with their documents, their data, and access to their systems. As we grow, so does the number of cloud environments we're responsible for, and we need someone whose full focus is keeping them secure.



This is a Long-Term Career Opportunity



We're looking for an engineer who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location & Type

- Remote

- Full-time (40 hours/week), on Netherlands business hours

What You'll Do



You'll join our infrastructure side, next to our current DevOps engineer, and help run the cloud environments behind every client project and product we ship. Where the rest of the team builds features, you make sure what we deploy is locked down, monitored, and costs what it should.



- Harden Azure environments: set up and maintain secure environments across client projects and our own products

- Own identity and access: Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, least privilege everywhere

- Secure the network: private endpoints, VNets, firewalls, public exposure kept to what's actually needed

- Monitor and respond: logging, alerting, Defender for Cloud, and being the first to know when something is off

- Review before go
 security checks on new deployments, and on existing ones on a regular schedule

- Secure the pipeline: CI/CD, container images, dependencies, vulnerability scanning

- Support compliance: help answer client security questionnaires and support ISO 27001, NIS2 and GDPR work

- Watch the costs: catch the mistakes that turn into a surprise invoice

- Document everything: so the knowledge of how our environments are set up doesn't live in one person's head

Must-Have Skills:



- 3+ years hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, with at least part of that on security

- Docker and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps)

title: Real Estate Media Production & Delivery Assistant — Part-Time VA
description:
Estate Productions is a real estate photography and video company based in North Carolina. I’m looking for an organized, reliable virtual assistant to help manage what happens after each shoot from organizing files to coordinating editors and preparing client deliveries.



I currently handle all photography and videography myself. We already outsource photo and video editing, so your role will be to keep production organized, on schedule, and ready for delivery.



Your responsibilities



Organize uploaded photos and video footage into clearly labeled property folders.



Submit photos to AutoHDR using our instructions, download finished images, and flag obvious editing issues.



Prepare video editing briefs using my notes, voice recordings, and reference links.



Send footage and instructions to our video editing company.



Track deadlines, follow up with editors, and communicate revision requests.



Check finished assets for missing files, incorrect spelling, and requested deliverables.



Upload completed content to our delivery platform and prepare client delivery messages.



Maintain a job tracker showing each project’s status, deadline, and next step.



You’ll start with file organization and production coordination. As you learn our workflow, you may also help with client delivery and routine client communication.



Who I’m looking for



Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.



Clear written English.



Reliable internet capable of uploading and downloading large media files.



Comfort working with cloud storage, spreadsheets, and online software.



Ability to follow checklists, meet deadlines, and ask questions when something is unclear.



Someone interested in a consistent, long-term working relationship.



Experience supporting a photographer, video editor, or real estate media company is a plus. Experience with AutoHDR or Aryeo is helpful but not required—we’ll provide training on our workflow.



Schedule and compensation



This is a remote, part-time position. We’ll agree on a consistent schedule that aligns with our North Carolina production and delivery deadlines. Please include your available hours and time zone in your application.



Please provide your expected hourly rate in USD. Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical trial before we commit to an ongoing arrangement.



How to apply



Use “Estate Productions — Production Assistant” as your application subject line and include:



A short introduction and your relevant experience.



Your available working hours and time zone.



Your expected hourly rate in USD.



Your internet upload and download speeds.



Any experience managing photo/video files or coordinating editors.



Your answer to this question: If an editor misses a deadline and a client’s delivery is due soon, what would you do?



I’m looking for someone who can become a dependable part of the team and help me spend more time shooting and growing the business.

title: Medical Billing Revenue Support Specialist
description:
Part Time Insurance Verification Specialist / Revenue Support , US Medical Billing



WHAT THIS IS



Part time, 20 to 25 hours per week. 

$500 per month, split twice a month on the 5th and the 20th.



Long term and dedicated. You work for me only, not for a pool or a queue.



I run a medical billing company in Los Angeles handling billing for outpatient physical therapy practices. You would be the first person I hire, working directly with me. The role will grow as the company does, and so will the pay.



THE WORK



Calling US insurance companies to verify patient eligibility and benefits. This is most of the job and you will have a written script for it.



Working in insurance portals. Some payers do not take phone calls for eligibility, so you will be pulling benefits directly from Blue Shield, Availity, and others. You will have logins and I will show you where everything lives.



Submitting prior authorization requests and following up until they are approved.



Calling insurance companies about unpaid claims to find out what is holding them up, and reporting back.



Tracking how many visits are left on each patient's authorization and flagging the ones running low.



Daily tasks from a list I send you. Some days that is all calls. Some days I will need help with something else. I want someone who can pick up whatever is in front of them.



As you learn the work there is room to take on more. The pay grows with the responsibility.



HOURS



You need to work US Pacific business hours, roughly 11pm to 8am Manila time, Monday through Friday. The insurance companies and portals are only open then, so this is not flexible.



Around 4 to 5 hours per day. We can agree on the exact window.



If you have not worked a graveyard shift before, please do not apply. It is harder than people expect.



WHAT MAKES YOU A FIT



You have worked in medical software before. A practice management system, an electronic health record, a billing platform, a clearinghouse portal. I am not looking to teach someone what a claim is. Tell me which systems you have used.



Clear spoken English. You will be on the phone with American insurance representatives every day. They talk fast and they will mishear you. This matters more than anything else on this list.



You follow a checklist exactly and you do not guess. If something is missing, you flag it. You never fill in a blank with your best guess.



You write down numbers accurately and read them back to confirm.



You can work on your own without being chased. I will give you the list, you work it, you tell me when something does not make sense.



WHAT I AM NOT LOOKING FOR



Agencies. I want one person I work with directly.



Someone juggling five other clients. Part time does not mean occasional.



HOW TO APPLY



Send me a message with:



A short voice recording, one minute is plenty, telling me about your experience and which medical systems you have worked in. I need to hear how you sound on the phone.

Your answer to this: a patient has a $3,400 deductible and has paid $257.57 toward it. How much is remaining?

The word "claims" at the top of your message so I know you read the whole posting.



Applications without all three will not get a reply.



Cristian

title: Senior SEO Developer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them.



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

 • Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

 • Crawlability and indexation

 • Site architecture and internal linking

 • Canonicalization and rendering issues

 • Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

 • Work directly within:

 • WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

 • Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

 • PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

 • Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

 • Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

 • Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

 • Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

 • 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

 • Comfortable editing live websites and templates

 • Working knowledge of:

 • HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

 • PHP and Shopify Liquid

 • Experience working directly inside:

 • WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

 • Strong understanding of:

 • Google Search Console

 • Ahrefs / Semrush

 • Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

 • Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

 • Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

 • Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

 • Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

 • Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

 • This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

 • Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

 • You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself

title: Remote Construction Operations Coordinator – Scaffolding & Solar
description:
Remote Construction Operations Coordinator – Scaffolding & Solar



Green Grid Scaffolding Ltd

Remote | Freelance | Part-time / On-demand

£6–£10 per hour depending on experience



About Green Grid



Green Grid Scaffolding supplies and coordinates scaffolding for solar installers and renewable-energy contractors across the UK.



We have a nationwide network of scaffolding partners and are looking for a reliable, commercially minded Construction Operations Coordinator to help us manage enquiries and live projects.



This is not a general virtual assistant role.



We are looking for someone with experience in construction coordination, estimating, subcontractor management, project administration or similar who can eventually take ownership of straightforward jobs from quotation through to completion.



What you'll do



When a scaffold enquiry comes in, you will take responsibility for coordinating the job.



Your work will include:



Review customer enquiries, drawings, photographs and site information.

Identify missing information needed to prepare a quotation.

Prepare scaffold quotations using our pricing system and agreed rates.

Issue quotations and manage straightforward customer queries.

Contact scaffolding contractors within our nationwide supplier network.

Obtain and confirm subcontractor pricing.

Once a job is won, select and book the appropriate scaffolding partner.

Coordinate erection dates, site access and requirements between the customer and scaffolder.

Confirm attendance before scheduled dates.

Follow up on the day to ensure the scaffolder has attended.

Obtain completion photographs and confirmation that the scaffold has been erected correctly and to the expected standard.

Coordinate routine issues, delays or remedial works.

Keep the customer updated.

Once the solar installation is complete, arrange the scaffold dismantling/strike.

Confirm the scaffold has been removed and the job is fully complete.

Keep our job tracker, costs, supplier information and project records up to date.

Help us build a strong database of reliable scaffolding partners across the UK.

Who we're looking for



Ideally you already have experience in:



Construction estimating, project coordination, construction administration, roofing, scaffolding, solar, subcontractor coordination or logistics.



You should also have:



Excellent written and spoken English.

Confidence speaking with UK customers and construction contractors.

Strong organisation and attention to detail.

Good commercial awareness and confidence working with costs and quotations.

Ability to read basic drawings, photographs and project information.

Confidence chasing subcontractors and holding people to agreed dates.

Good Excel/Google Sheets skills.

Reliable internet and your own computer.

Availability during UK business hours when live jobs require attention.



Previous scaffolding experience is not essential. We can teach you our pricing and operating process. Construction experience and the ability to learn quickly are more important.



Hours & Pay



This is a freelance, on-demand position.



Initially, hours will vary depending on the number of enquiries and live projects Green Grid has.



Some weeks may only require a few hours; busier weeks will require more.



There are no guaranteed minimum hours initially.







As Green Grid grows, there is significant opportunity for the hours and responsibility of this position to grow with the business.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of our operations, rather than someone looking for a short-term project.



How to Apply



Please send a short introduction explaining your relevant construction/estimating/project coordination experience.



Then answer this question:



A solar installer sends you photographs and details of a two-storey house and needs scaffolding erected next Wednesday. Talk us through what you would do from receiving the enquiry, preparing the quote and booking the scaffolder through to making sure the scaffold is erected successfully and eventually dismantled.



Please start your application with the words “GREEN GRID” so we know you have read the full job description.

title: ServiceTitan Administrator & Operations Support Specialist
description:
About our company

JB’s is a veteran-owned construction and home-services business based in Northwest Florida. We serve our neighbors through electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, remodeling, construction, and related services.

We are looking for an experienced ServiceTitan Administrator who can become our internal ServiceTitan Champion.

Our goal is straightforward: our team needs a knowledgeable person who can answer questions, solve problems, complete administrative work, maintain the system, and help us use ServiceTitan effectively—without every issue going back to the owner.

This is a hands-on execution role, not a consulting-only position. We need someone who can both explain what needs to happen and complete the work.

Your primary responsibility

Take ownership of day-to-day ServiceTitan administration and internal support.

When a team member has a question or something is not working properly, you will investigate, resolve what is within your authority, coordinate with ServiceTitan support when necessary, and follow the issue through to a verified resolution.

You are not expected to know every answer immediately. You are expected to know how to investigate, find reliable answers, communicate clearly, and follow through.

What you will own

Team support and troubleshooting

Be the first point of contact for ServiceTitan questions from our office, technicians, sales staff, and managers. Help team members understand the correct workflow and investigate problems involving customer records, jobs, estimates, invoices, memberships, mobile usage, and system settings.

Distinguish between a training issue, a configuration issue, missing information, and a problem that requires ServiceTitan support.

Daily administration and system maintenance

Complete approved updates to records, templates, forms, job types, business units, and other settings within your assigned scope. Maintain a visible request list so important work does not get forgotten.

Identify incomplete or inconsistent records, investigate the cause, and coordinate corrections with the responsible department. Do not guess at missing financial information or change records simply to make a report look correct.

Pricebook maintenance

Maintain our approved pricebook structure, descriptions, categories, images, and related information. Implement approved service, material, equipment, and pricing updates.

Work with management and accounting to identify missing information or setup problems. Pricing strategy, margin targets, and accounting-policy decisions remain with authorized leadership.

For bulk changes, document the starting point, validate the proposed changes, obtain required approval, and verify the results after implementation.

Reporting and data quality

Prepare and maintain useful reports for management, including approved views of department performance, sales, completed work, unsold estimates, memberships, and job-cost information where available.

Understand what a report measures, which dates and filters it uses, and what information may be incomplete. Investigate discrepancies instead of simply forwarding a spreadsheet to the owner.

Maintain recurring report delivery and help managers understand how to use their reports.

Training and documentation

Create short, practical instructions and screen-recorded walkthroughs for recurring tasks. Train new employees on the workflows relevant to their roles and help existing employees correct repeated mistakes.

Maintain a JB’s ServiceTitan knowledge library so the same questions do not need to be answered from scratch repeatedly.

Help translate our approved operating procedures and Nexstar-based service processes into practical system workflows.

ServiceTitan support and vendor follow-through

Own support cases from initial investigation through resolution. Provide clear examples, relevant screenshots, affected record identifiers, and steps already attempted.

Attend appropriate support or account meetings, document action items, and complete approved follow-up work. Escalate decisions requiring management approval with a clear explanation and recommended next step.

Connected tools and ongoing improvements

Help investigate problems involving our approved ServiceTitan-connected tools, including website booking and other integrations we use.

Coordinate with vendors or technical specialists where needed. Advanced programming is not a core requirement, but you should be able to explain a problem clearly and test whether a fix works.

Recommend practical improvements while working within our existing subscriptions and approved budget.

Required experience

You must have at least two years of meaningful, hands-on ServiceTitan experience, including administration, configuration, troubleshooting, reporting, or implementation work.

Experience limited to call answering, appointment booking, or dispatching is not sufficient by itself.

You should be able to demonstrate:

- ServiceTitan administrative work you personally completed, including pricebook maintenance and reporting.

- Successful troubleshooting and the ability to explain a workflow to a nontechnical team member.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, attention to detail, and careful handling of imports or bulk changes.

- Clear written and spoken English, dependable live availability, and independent follow-through.

Experience supporting U.S. HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other home-service businesses is strongly preferred.

Preferred qualifications

ServiceTitan Certified Administrator certification is preferred. Please identify your credential and current status.

Experience with multi-trade businesses, memberships, job costing, QuickBooks integration support, purchasing or inventory workflows, and Nexstar-based operations is helpful.

Please be honest about which areas you know well and which would require additional training.

Authority and working relationships

You will report to the owner and work closely with our call-center manager, service manager, sales professional, and accounting support.

You will own system support and execution, not override department leaders.

Dispatch priorities, customer commitments, pricing policy, financial approvals, and employee-management decisions remain with the appropriate manager or owner.

You must obtain approval before making high-impact changes, enabling paid services, changing financial mappings, expanding access, or making changes that affect multiple departments.

What success looks like

Our team knows where to go for ServiceTitan help. Routine issues get handled without the owner becoming involved. Approved changes are completed accurately. Reports are dependable and clearly explained. Recurring problems lead to better training or a corrected process.

Most importantly, you make ServiceTitan easier for our team to use while reducing the owner’s daily administrative workload.

How to apply

Apply with the subject:

JB’s ServiceTitan Champion — Your Name

Include your résumé, expected monthly compensation, availability, and answers to these questions:

1. How long have you worked in ServiceTitan, and what administrative responsibilities did you personally own?

2. Describe a difficult ServiceTitan problem you investigated and resolved. What did you check, change, and verify?

3. What pricebook and reporting work have you completed yourself?

4. Have you trained other employees or managed ServiceTitan support cases? Give an example.

5. Which ServiceTitan areas are your strongest, and which would require additional training?

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment and live walkthrough using provided sample information or an appropriately controlled environment.

Do not submit confidential information, customer records, or unauthorized screenshots from another employer.

You'll be as comfortable reviewing an technical specifications as you are presenting a project status to a steering committee. You'll run the sprints, manage the risks, keep the client informed, and make sure the team has everything they need to deliver great work.



You'll take full ownership of project outcomes - scope, timeline, budget, quality. When things go sideways (and they will), you'll be the one who stays calm, works the problem, and gets things back on track.

- Own the client relationship: deliver status reports, present to steering committees, and manage expectations proactively

- Manage risk: maintain RAID logs, surface issues early, and always come with a recommendation

- Plan capacity: forecast resourcing across projects and coordinate with leadership on team allocation

- Remove blockers: shield the delivery team from noise and make sure they can focus on building



What We're Looking For



- 5+ years delivering IT projects in a consulting or professional services environment

- Bachelor's degree (engineering background a plus)

 and incoming requests

Follows up without waiting to be reminded

Can manage multiple patients, therapists, applicants,
s, and projects at the same time

Can work independently after learning our systems and processes

Is dependable and responsive during scheduled hours

Is comfortable working with spreadsheets,
, cloud-based systems, and EMRs

Takes ownership of completing tasks rather than simply checking boxes



We are looking for someone who thinks:



“I noticed this was still outstanding, so I followed up.”



rather than:



“Nobody told me to follow up.”



Experience



U.S. healthcare experience is strongly preferred.



Particularly relevant experience includes:



Home health

Medical virtual assistant work

PT/OT/SLP or therapy companies

Referral coordination or intake

Healthcare staffing or recruiting

Medical scheduling

EMR/EHR systems

Medical terminology

Provider/therapist communication

Healthcare documentation

HIPAA-regulated environments

Experience with some of the following is helpful:

Google Sheets

QuickBooks

TherapyBOSS

EMR/EHR platforms

Begin your application with the words: BLUE FOLDER

• Excellent written English  

• Strong attention to detail  

• Excellent organization and time-management skills  

• Ability to work independently without constant supervision  

• Reliable computer and internet connection  

• Comfortable learning and using our CRM and dispute-management systems  

• Ability to handle confidential client information professionally  



IMPORTANT: We are looking for someone who understands that disputes should be based on the client's actual circumstances and documentation. We are not looking for someone who simply sends the same generic dispute template for every client.

### Job Requirements



- Demonstrated experience bringing projects from an initial brief to completion.

- Strong initiative and the ability to work independently within approved scope.

- Excellent research, problem-solving, organization, and follow-through skills.

- Ability to understand instructions quickly, retain important details, and ask focused questions.

-
 marketing and customer relationship management systems.

Our customers are our neighbors. Our marketing should feel trustworthy, professional, helpful, and connected to the communities we serve.

What you will own

Marketing calendar and content production. Prepare and maintain a monthly marketing calendar. Create branded social posts, project spotlights, before-and-after content, short videos, educational content, and seasonal promotions.

Project-photo and content collection. Coordinate with our team to obtain useful project photos, videos, and job details. Organize approved assets so content creation does not depend on the owner finding material for you.

Social media and Google Business Profile. Schedule approved content, maintain accurate information, monitor engagement, draft appropriate responses, and flag customer-service issues to the correct manager.

Website content and routine updates. Update approved content, photos, offers, and basic service-page information in WordPress. Check that published information and lead forms are accurate, and coordinate technical problems with the appropriate specialist.

 campaigns, membership promotions, flyers, and other materials using approved messaging and brand standards. Coordinate production artwork and vendor requirements when specialist design work is needed.

Performance reporting. Report what was published, which campaigns ran, what inquiries were generated, and where tracking is incomplete. Work with our office and sales team to connect marketing activity with qualified inquiries, booked appointments, and sold work.

Required qualifications

At least two years of hands-on digital-marketing experience, with a portfolio showing your own work.

Strong English writing, Canva or comparable design skills, social-media scheduling experience, and basic WordPress content-editing ability are required.

Experience with local service businesses, construction companies, Google Business Profile,
 marketing, and simple video editing is preferred.

Please clearly identify what you personally created or managed in each portfolio example.

Scope and working expectations

This role focuses on consistent marketing execution. Advanced website development, complex technical SEO, and high-budget paid-ad management are not automatically part of the position.

You must follow approved branding, service areas, pricing, and offers. Do not invent customer testimonials, use project photos without authorization, or publish unsupported promises.

How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject “JB’s Marketing — Your Name.”

title: AI Output Evaluator
description:
AI Output Evaluator



We are looking for a detail-oriented, highly disciplined Independent Contractor to evaluate AI-generated outputs (images, videos, audio, and text) for a U.S.-based AI training project.



The Work:

You will compare two AI-generated responses side-by-side and determine which one better satisfies a specific prompt based on observable evidence. You will be trained on our strict evaluation rubric and expected to write brief, evidence-based justifications for your choices.



Technical Requirements (Mandatory):

• All work MUST be performed on a provided AWS Virtual Machine (VM) accessed via Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP).

• You are strictly prohibited from using your personal computer, personal browser, or personal storage devices for task work.

• You must have a stable internet connection capable of maintaining a consistent RDP connection.

• You may not install any software on the AWS VM.



Compliance & Rules (Zero Tolerance):

• You must only work on tasks you are authorized to do (we will provide required attributes).

• You must log accurate active work hours. Time fraud (logging hours not actively worked) is grounds for immediate termination.

• Absolutely no use of ChatGPT, Claude, or any external AI tools to assist with evaluations.

• Strict confidentiality is required. You may not screenshot, copy, or share any task materials.

• Maximum 14 hours per day / 40 hours per week.



Schedule & Pay:

title: Performance Graphic Designer
description:
Performance Graphic Designer



Important:

Please do not apply if your portfolio is mainly personal art, print-only branding, wedding/event invitations, or generic corporate design without DTC direct-response experience.



We are not looking for a normal graphic designer.



We are looking for someone who knows how to turn a raw product shot and a rough idea into a winning creatives.



Your job is not just to make things look good. Your job is to help us create static and carousel ads that stop the scroll, hold attention, build desire, and drive sales across
, Instagram, TikTok, and marketplace platforms (Shopee, Lazada).



If you understand hooks, comparison and value-stack graphics, direct-response design, emotional selling, UGC-style visuals, AI-assisted design, and fast iteration, we want to hear from you.



You’ll be responsible for:

1. Designing high-performing static and carousel ads for paid social

2. Creating multiple variations from one concept or brief

3. Improving ad creatives based on performance feedback

4. Using AI tools to speed up ideation, mockups, retouching, and background/scene creation

5. Adding product callouts, comparison graphics, captions, and clean layouts that make claims easy to understand at a glance

6. Supporting organic social content alongside your ad creative work

7. Reviewing designs from the team and giving clear feedback to improve quality

8. Working closely with a growth-focused team that cares about growth and results



You'll Be Designing

1. Meta Image Ads 
 & Instagram)

Scroll-stopping static and carousel ads built for paid social. This means designing for attention in the first frame, integrating hooks and copy directly into the visual, following platform specs (aspect ratios, text-to-image ratio, safe zones), and producing multiple variations of the same concept for A/B testing. This is direct-response design — every choice should serve conversion, not just aesthetics.



2. Product Listing Images (Shopify, Shopee, Amazon, TikTok Shop)

Main and gallery images for product listings across our e-commerce storefronts and marketplaces. Each platform has its own rules and conventions — Amazon's strict main-image requirements, Shopee/TikTok Shop's infographic-heavy slide format, Shopify's flexibility for lifestyle shots. You'll need to communicate features, specs, and value props clearly within a handful of image slots, and design within each platform's compliance guidelines.



3. Email Marketing Graphics

Banner images, promotional graphics, and visual assets for email campaigns (e.g. Klaviyo flows — welcome series, abandoned cart, promotions). These need to be lightweight, mobile-responsive, and designed to work seamlessly within email templates and alongside copy — not standalone art pieces.



4. Website Landing Pages (Replo/CF/Pagefly/Gempages experience preferred)

Designing and building landing pages for Shopify's Landing Pages, campaigns and product launches — hero sections, benefit blocks, testimonials, FAQs, and CTAs. Experience building directly in Replo (or a similar visual page builder like Shopify's native page editor) is a strong plus, since this role may involve assembling pages, not just handing off static designs.



5. Social Media Organic Images

Feed posts, carousels, and graphics for non-paid social content. This is a different register from ad design — more native, community-oriented, and trend-aware, less overtly "salesy." Consistency with brand aesthetic and quick turnaround matter more here than heavy testing.



You may be a fit if:

1. You have experience designing paid social ads & landing pages

2. You understand what makes an ad and Landing pages convert, not just look nice

3. You can think like a performance marketer, not just a designer

4. You move fast, take feedback well, and enjoy testing creative ideas

5. You’re comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow

title: Senior Bookkeeper / Accounting Specialist — U.S. Construction & Home Services
description:
Type of work: Full-time, remote

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday

Suggested salary: $6/hr USD, based on demonstrated experience

Schedule: At least four hours of daily overlap with U.S. Central business hours; remaining hours agreed upon

Job overview

JB’s Contracting & Maintenance / JB’s Home Services is a veteran-owned construction and home-services business based in Northwest Florida. We serve homeowners through construction, remodeling, roofing, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and related services.

We are looking for an experienced bookkeeper/accounting specialist to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and financial reporting.

This is not an entry-level data-entry position. We need someone who understands the numbers, identifies missing information, follows up professionally, and maintains accurate records without the owner having to manage every transaction.

What you will own

Daily bookkeeping and documentation. Maintain accurate QuickBooks records; collect and organize receipts, bills, and supporting documents; match transactions; identify duplicates; and resolve missing information with the appropriate team member.

Banking, credit cards, and account reconciliations. Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts, investigate discrepancies, maintain loan and liability schedules, and document unresolved items rather than guessing or making unsupported adjustments.

Accounts payable and receivable. Maintain vendor-bill and customer-balance reports, prepare payment-approval lists, coordinate routine invoice follow-ups, and flag overdue balances or billing discrepancies.

Job costs and department reporting. Track labor, materials, subcontractors, and other direct costs by job and department. Coordinate with our operating systems and team so management can compare estimated costs with actual costs.

Payroll and commission preparation. Collect approved time and supporting information, prepare payroll inputs for management and our payroll provider, reconcile payroll postings, and prepare commission worksheets using our approved compensation plans.

Monthly reporting. Complete an agreed month-end checklist and prepare profit-and-loss, balance-sheet, receivables, payables, and job-profitability reports. Provide a brief explanation of unusual changes, missing information, and items requiring management attention.

Required qualifications

At least three years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, including experience supporting U.S. businesses. Strong QuickBooks and spreadsheet skills are required. Please specify your experience with QuickBooks Online, Desktop, or both.

You must be comfortable with full account reconciliations, the relationship between the balance sheet and profit-and-loss statement, and the difference between gross margin and markup.

Construction, contracting, or home-services experience is strongly preferred. Job-costing experience is particularly important. An accounting degree or professional accounting credential is welcome, but demonstrated competence matters more than a title alone.

Working expectations

You will prepare and reconcile financial information, but you will not independently authorize payments, change vendor banking details, approve refunds, or make tax-policy decisions.

We value accuracy, confidentiality, clear communication, and early reporting of problems. We would rather receive a thoughtful question than an unsupported assumption.

How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject “JB’s Accounting — Your Name.”

Include your résumé, expected monthly compensation, availability, and short answers to these questions:

1. What bookkeeping work have you personally handled for U.S. contractors or home-service companies?

2. Describe your month-end closing process.

3. How would you record a payment from a checking account to a business credit card without duplicating expenses?

4. What would you do when a transaction is missing a receipt or job assignment?

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment using sample data, followed by an interview.

Suggested skill tags: Bookkeeping, QuickBooks, Accounting.

description:
✦ CREATIVE DESIGNER AND OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

Remote | Australian Event Design Studio

This role combines creative design with the practical coordination behind our projects. You’ll create polished concepts and presentations while also helping manage proposals, client correspondence, project information and everyday administration.



✦ WHO WE ARE



We are a Sydney-based premium event design studio creating weddings, corporate events and bespoke celebrations throughout Australia.



Our clients come to us for thoughtful design and a complete experience. Our presentations help them visualise their event before it happens, while our administration and coordination help turn that vision into reality.

Using our professionally designed Canva templates, creative direction and project information, you’ll customise presentations to reflect each client’s vision.



You’ll thoughtfully incorporate furniture, florals, décor, colour palettes and layouts, paying attention to scale, proportion and composition.



Alongside the design work, you’ll help keep proposals, client communication, project documents and deadlines organised. You must be comfortable switching between creative work and detailed administration.



We provide templates, systems and guidance, but we also want someone who contributes ideas, identifies missing information and takes initiative.



✦ CREATIVE DESIGN RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create wedding concepts, corporate event presentations and styling mock-ups.

• Develop mood boards, colour palettes and cohesive visual concepts.

• Customise Canva templates into polished client presentations.

• Incorporate furniture, florals and styling elements with appropriate scale and proportion.

• Prepare event stationery and signage concepts.

• Refine designs following feedback and maintain accurate versions.

• Organise design assets and template libraries.

• Assist with branding and social media graphics as the role develops.



✦ OPERATIONS AND ADMIN RESPONSIBILITIES



• Assist with preparing and updating proposals in Quotient using approved scope and pricing.

• Ensure presentations, proposal descriptions and supporting information are consistent.

• Respond professionally to routine client enquiries and help gather outstanding information.

• Coordinate revisions and approvals with the Creative Director and office team.

• Support our Office Manager and Director with day-to-day administration.



Accuracy matters as much as presentation. The right person will notice an incorrect quantity, missing detail or approaching deadline as readily as a design that needs refinement.



✦ HOW YOU’LL WORK WITH US



1. CLIENT DISCOVERY

Our Creative Director meets with the client to understand their vision, style and requirements.



2. BRIEF AND PROPOSAL

The team develops the creative direction, scope and pricing. You’ll help organise the information and prepare the proposal.



3. DESIGN AND MOCK-UPS

You’ll create concepts and presentations that help the client visualise their event.



4. REVIEW AND REFINEMENT

We’ll review the work together, refine the details and prepare it for presentation.



5. PROJECT COORDINATION

You’ll help keep approved information, correspondence and planning documents accurate and up to date.



✦ ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



• Previous Interior Design experience, with a strong understanding of space, layout, colour, styling, scale and visual composition.

• Strong Canva skills and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful, polished design.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong organisation, attention to detail and time management.

• Confidence communicating professionally with clients and suppliers.

• Ability to work efficiently, manage revisions and meet deadlines.

• Initiative and sound judgment when working independently.

• Comfort with both creative work and routine administration.

• A reliable computer, internet connection and suitable workspace.



Experience in weddings, events or luxury brands is highly regarded.



Experience with Quotient, 
 and Google Workspace would be an advantage.



✦ WHAT WE OFFER

Include the reference image and send your Canva link or PDF. We’d like to see your interpretation, composition and attention to detail.

What you'll do:

Nice to have:

Pay and benefits:

- Bi-weekly payment

- Flexible schedule: work whenever you want, as long as it's done on time with 40 hours a week

- Flexible time off if requested



APPLICATION TEST (required, about 15 minutes)



Part 1 - Rank these 5 reels from most viral to least viral, based on how you think a US audience reacted:



Reel A: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Cujv2eZop_2Q56gApvJbsi160IxYeWYm/view

Reel B: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CNB5c-DK70V1xLlVcbEMnIN8M4gltMXn/view

title: B2B Inbound & Outbound Sales & Client Services Representative
description:
B2B Commercial Sales & Client Services Representative



ABOUT US

--------------------

We are an e-commerce business specializing in hydroponic equipment serving North America. We are a small, dynamic team looking for a long-term partner who will become the primary customer representative of the company.



ABOUT THE ROLE

--------------------

We're hiring a remote dedicated B2B Sales & Client Services Representative to own the front line of sales and customer service experience.



As a key member, you'll have the opportunity to work remotely while directly shaping the success of our valued customers.



You'll answer calls, chats,
s, walk customers through our products, and close sales — while qualifying larger commercial leads for handoff to our sales manager.





Hours: 8am to 1pm PST



WHAT YOU'LL DO

--------------------

Answer inbound calls promptly — pick up live calls within a few rings or less.

Resolve routine retail support — shipment tracking, parts questions, order status, and general customer inquiries, start to finish.

Re-engage abandoned-cart shoppers and follow up on stalled quotes through outbound and cold calling.

Walk customers through our product lineup with clarity, confidence, and accurate detail

Work through objections, pricing pushback, and follow-ups without losing momentum, while staying alert to upsell and cross-sell openings.

Qualify incoming commercial inquiries — run a short intake call to understand scope and need, then hand off pre-qualified leads to our sales manager with clear notes.

Own the queue during scheduled leadership absences — during planned coverage windows, you're the single point of contact for all customer communications. High-value orders and urgent escalations get flagged for a same-day leadership review; everything else you handle directly.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

--------------------

Callers consistently reach a real person quickly — no missed calls, no long holds.

Retail issues get resolved on first contact whenever possible.

100% of leads are entered into the CRM, ready and pre-qualified for the sales manager.

Leadership can step away (including multi-day stretches) without customer experience slipping.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

--------------------

Experience in customer support, inside sales, or sales development — retail, e-commerce, or B2B distribution background is a plus.

Clear, confident spoken and written English communication skills, with an outgoing, people-first personality.

Sharp communication paired with genuine listening skills — comfortable being the first voice a customer hears, on the phone and in writing.

Organized and self-directed — you can triage, prioritize, and make good judgment calls without someone looking over your shoulder.

Calm, professional communication style with both everyday retail customers and commercial buyers.

Quick to learn, dependable in execution, and careful with instructions.



BONUS POINTS FOR

--------------------

Comfortable working daily inside Shopify to track orders, leads, monitor abandoned carts, and flag opportunities.

Familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

Understanding of AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude AI, etc.



HOW TO APPLY (MUST READ)

--------------------

Send the following:



Your resume

A 60–90 second voice recording (required) covering both parts below:



Voice Recording — what to include:



A. Quick intro: your name and one sentence on your background & sales experience.



B. Live sales scenario: Imagine you're calling a customer who added a vacuum cleaner to their cart but didn't check out. Walk us through how you'd turn that abandoned cart into a sale — including how you'd handle the objection "I'm not ready to buy right now."



We're evaluating tone, confidence, clarity, listening cues, and how naturally you move a prospect toward a close. Polish matters; perfection isn't expected — show us how you actually sound on a real call.



Applications without a voice recording that completes both parts will not be considered. Please include the word REAL in your subject line to confirm you've read this far.



Thank you.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
Furnished Unfurnished (FUF) is a rental marketplace connecting people seeking stays of 30 days or longer with furnished and unfurnished housing.



We’re looking for a hands-on marketer who can build a growth plan, execute campaigns, and turn results into better decisions. You’ll lead marketing to both landlords and tenants, working alongside our business development team, which handles direct landlord and vendor recruitment.



We value clear thinking, ownership, and careful execution. Small details matter when you’re working with customer messages, campaign budgets, and conversion data.



What you’ll do

- Build and execute campaigns that attract quality listings and qualified tenants

- Choose acquisition channels based on audience, budget, and results

- Write and test
s, landing-page copy, and campaign content

- Develop follow-up campaigns that turn interest into inquiries and active listings

- Coordinate with business development so campaigns support their outreach

- Track conversions, campaign costs, and results, then recommend what to improve



Your first message should begin with FUF, followed by a brief introduction. We’re interested in what you’ve personally delivered and how you think through a marketing problem.



What we’re looking for

- Proven experience planning and executing campaigns that generated qualified leads or paying customers

- Strong written English and persuasive copywriting

- Practical
 marketing experience and depth in at least one acquisition channel

- Confidence with analytics, conversion tracking, and testing

- Ability to prioritize and work independently while collaborating with a small team



Marketplace, rental housing, or real estate experience is helpful. You don’t need to know every marketing channel, but you should know how to choose where to focus.



Include a viewable resume link and two campaign examples in your application. For each example, explain the starting point, your personal contribution, and the measurable outcome. Share only work you have permission to disclose.



How we’ll measure success

We care about qualified tenant inquiries, landlords who publish complete listings, conversion improvements, and acquisition costs. Rentals are finalized directly between tenants and landlords, so results need to go beyond clicks and impressions.



Alongside your examples, answer this in two or three sentences: Your campaign generates plenty of tenant inquiries, but very few are qualified. What would you check first, and why?



Compensation and schedule

Up to $2,000 USD per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated results. Remote. Weekly hours and required U.S. overlap will be agreed before hiring.



Applications are reviewed through Instagram at kwaykuu. Send your resume and the details requested in this post via DM. Include your expected monthly salary and weekly availability.



We’re looking for someone who can explain their work clearly, show credible results, and follow through carefully.

title: Virtual Assistant for Short Term Rental Business (Uplisting / PriceLabs / Airbnb / Booking.com)
description:
Shirestone Property Management is a UK based short term rental management company. We look after a growing portfolio of serviced accommodation and holiday let properties on behalf of owners, and we pride ourselves on fast guest communication, high occupancy and spotless listings. We are looking for a reliable, detail focused VA to take the day to day admin off our plate so we can focus on growing the portfolio.

What You Will Be Doing

Managing guest communication across Airbnb, Booking.com and direct enquiries, replying quickly and professionally

Handling bookings, amendments, cancellations and extensions inside Uplisting

Monitoring and adjusting pricing in PriceLabs, flagging gaps in the calendar and opportunities to fill them

Coordinating cleaners and maintenance, sending schedules and confirming turnovers are completed

Keeping listings accurate and up to date across all channels, including photos, descriptions and house rules

Chasing reviews from guests and responding to reviews we receive

Reporting any issues, damage or complaints to the team straight away

Basic weekly reporting on occupancy, bookings and any outstanding tasks

What We Are Looking For

Previous experience working in short term rentals, serviced accommodation or property management

Hands on experience with Uplisting (or a similar channel manager such as Hospitable, Guesty or Hostaway)

Working knowledge of PriceLabs or another dynamic pricing tool

Confident using the Airbnb and Booking.com extranets

Excellent written English, warm and professional tone with guests

Highly organised, able to work independently and follow systems without being chased

Reliable internet connection and a quiet place to work

Able to overlap with UK working hours

Nice To Have

Experience with Google Workspace, Slack or WhatsApp for team communication

Experience creating or improving SOPs

Familiarity with UK guest expectations and UK based cleaning teams

Schedule

15 hours per week to start, spread across weekdays with some flexibility for weekend guest messages. There is scope to increase hours as the portfolio grows for the right person.

How To Apply

Please reply with the following:

Start your message with the word SHIRESTONE so we know you have read the full advert

A short summary of your short term rental experience, including how many properties you have managed

Which channel manager and pricing tools you have used, and for how long

Your available hours in UK time

Your expected monthly rate for 15 hours per week

title: Video Editor
description:
Overview:



Join our creative team as a Video Editor and help bring our clients' ideas to life. We're looking for a skilled and creative editor with strong storytelling abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the team.



You should be comfortable working across different types of video content and open to learning new tools, techniques, and workflows, including AI-assisted tools.



Key Responsibilities:



- Lead video projects from raw footage to final delivery.

- Edit long-form and short-form content, including YouTube videos, podcasts, interviews, ads, educational content, and social media videos.

- Use strong storytelling, pacing, B-roll, captions, motion graphics, transitions, visual effects, and sound design to enhance content.

- Repurpose long-form content into engaging short-form clips and adapt videos for different platforms and formats.

- Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining high-quality output.

- Collaborate with the team, understand project goals, and effectively implement feedback.

- Handle basic color correction, audio cleanup, sound mixing, and final mastering.

- Stay updated with editing trends, software, creative techniques, and AI-assisted tools that can improve the production workflow.



Requirements:



- Proven experience as a video editor with a strong portfolio.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro. Experience with After Effects and/or Final Cut Pro is a plus.

- Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, composition, sound, and visual flow.

- Experience editing both short-form and long-form videos, including videos longer than 15 minutes.

- Excellent communication and responsiveness to team interactions and feedback (VERY IMPORTANT!)

- Willingness to improve, learn, and listen to feedback (VERY IMPORTANT!)

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet tight deadlines.

- Familiarity with AI-powered video, image, audio, or editing tools is a plus.



Working Hours:



Initially, working hours are flexible but are expected to become more consistent in the following months.



Please submit:



- A portfolio showcasing your strongest or most complex video edit.

- A brief cover letter detailing the editing software and tools you use.

- A short overview of your editing experience and the types of content you've worked on.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a sample test edit as part of the selection process.
